mechanism: The July displacement (40 to 32) built a three-week shelf that never re-knit: zero ignitions, four of the last seven sessions with all-five readings displaced downward, and stability S_UF easing to its window low (0.808) as price presses marginal new lows. On the final session the reversal channel shut mid-day (Rev 1 to 0) and the unwind fraction decayed from 0.59 to 0.39 across the day, so the one channel that was holding the shelf up went quiet exactly at the floor. Stored tension from the decade-long relaxation (B pinned at -1.000, 71 lifetime channel deaths) has no opposing structure left; the field is resuming its downward relaxation rather than basing.
